# A10 report: UI

Branch `v2-a10-ui`, merged with `v2` after A07 and A11 landed. Everything is in `web/**`, the v1 UI routes in `server/routes/**`, A10's scripts (`scripts/a10/`, `scripts/ui-smoke/a10-*.ts`, `scripts/checks/a10-ui.ts`) and the screenshots in `design/shots/v2/`. No contract was edited; requests are in `docs/build/requests/A10.md`.

## What was built

### App shell (`web/src/App.tsx`, `kit.tsx`, `styles/app.css`)
- **Navigation** in three groups, no labels: daily (Overview, Campaigns, Pipeline, Questions, Inbox, Digests), work (Jobs, Studio, Dispatch, Forms, Learning), setup (Sources, Profile, Agents and API, Settings). Badges for open questions, unread inbox, jobs waiting on you and drafts come from `GET /api/shell`.
- **Live state and the kill switch.** While any campaign runs, a "Stop everything" button sits in the sidebar foot (desktop) and the top bar (phone), and every page without the sash gets a one-line live strip ("Backend roles is rehearsing. Next application in 14 min.") with the switch. Stopping asks once (optional reason), calls `POST /api/kill`, and the strip then says everything is stopped with a Clear button (`DELETE /api/kill`). Data/STOP is explained when it's the cause.
- **Phone (820 px and below):** the sidebar becomes a top bar (brand, kill switch, menu) plus a bottom tab bar for the five phone places: Campaigns, Pipeline, Questions, Inbox, Digests. The menu opens every page in a sheet. Safe-area insets respected; toasts sit above the tab bar; drawers become full-screen sheets.
- **Live updates:** the SSE stream now invalidates on every v2 bus event (`campaign.status`, `pipeline.state`, `question.answered`, `inbox.message`, `alert.interview`, `digest.sent`, `recipe.promoted`, `application.outcome`).
- **Shared kit:** `PageHead`, `Tabs`, `StateTag`, `Meter`, `Stat`, `Drawer`, `Hint`, `ScreenHint` (the "Chance of passing the screen" tooltip from `/api/match/meaning`), `Facts`, `CopyButton`, `NotSetUp`, and formatters (24-hour clock, `until`, `usd`, `atsLabel`).

### Server routes added (`server/routes/ui.ts`, registered from `systemRoutes`)

| Method | Path | What |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/api/onboarding` | Wizard progress (`current`, `completed`, `skipped`, `done`), what each step already has (CV, links, GitHub, voice count, answers filled, learning count, API key, SMTP/IMAP, Telegram, campaigns) and `firstRun` |
| PUT | `/api/onboarding` | `{ current?, complete?, skip?, done?, reset? }`; stored in the `ui.onboarding` setting |
| GET | `/api/shell` | Live flag, kill state, active/paused campaigns with dry-run flag, the current job with title and company, next apply time, badge counts, onboarding summary |
| GET | `/api/pipeline` | Pipeline rows across campaigns joined with the job, campaign name and latest application id, plus counts by state (`?state=a,b&campaignId=<id>\|none&q=&limit=`) |
| GET | `/api/pipeline/jobs/:id` | The job file for the timeline: job (sources, ATS, legitimacy and reasons, apply URL), pipeline row, applications (answers, shot flag, stage, origin), linked inbox messages, outcomes, unknown questions |

Changed v1 routes: `GET /api/applications?status=skipped` is accepted (A04 §3); `GET /api/applications/:id/shot.png` serves `<uuid>.jpg` proofs as `image/jpeg` (A07 §2), still only names matching the uuid pattern.

## How to run and test

- `npm run typecheck`: clean. `npm run selfcheck`: all 434 checks pass (1 pending on A09).
- `npm run selfcheck -- a10` (10 checks): onboarding save/skip/complete/reset/validation, the shell, pipeline listing / counts / search / `campaignId=none` / bad state, the job file and 404, the skipped filter, JPEG shots (and refusing other names), the manifest and icons, the service worker never touching `/api`, a design lint over `web/src` (no glyph icons, arrows, middle dots or em dashes in UI strings), and every page and phone tab the brief names.
- `npm run build && npm run ui-smoke`: **23 steps pass** on A11's runner (`scripts/ui-smoke/a10-1..4`):
  1. Onboarding: a fresh install opens the wizard; CV skipped; links saved; GitHub preview shown; a voice passage autosaves with a word count; answer groups shown; a learning skill added; key, mailbox and Telegram skipped; the first campaign starts in rehearsal; onboarding is marked done and stays done after a reload.
  2. Campaign: the editor opens with defaults; cap, rehearsal days and stretch level set; Save and start puts it active in dry run with those values; the sash shows; Pause takes it down and Resume puts it back.
  3. Kill switch: shown in the live strip on a page without the sash; stopping asks once, trips the switch and pauses every campaign; the strip says it's stopped and the switch disappears; clearing leaves campaigns paused.
  4. Questions: a planted unknown question shows with its badge; picking an option and saving puts it in the answer bank, marks it answered and re-queues the job (`skipped → selected`).
- Screenshots: `BUREAU_DATA_DIR=<temp> npx tsx scripts/a10/seed-demo.ts`, start the server on that dir (`BUREAU_REPLAY=1 BUREAU_EMBED=hash BUREAU_NOTIFY_OFFLINE=1`), then `BUREAU_URL=http://127.0.0.1:<port> npx tsx scripts/a10/shots.ts`. The seed is fictional (A04's scenario candidate, example.net employers), runs one real writer pass on A04's recordings, switches every source off so nothing touches the network, and keeps the campaign outside its active hours unless `--live`. 27 views × 2 widths = **54 PNGs in `design/shots/v2/`** (9 MB; pages are clipped at 2600 px desktop / 3200 px phone). The temp data dir and the server were removed afterwards.

## Design notes for review

- One bold element: the crimson sash appears only on Overview and Campaigns while a campaign is active and the kill switch is off. Elsewhere live state is a linen strip with a small crimson dot. One primary (crimson) button per view at most; the kill switch is crimson text, never a crimson block.
- Status by tone: olive for sent / healthy / passed, brass for needs-you / slow / rehearsing-related attention, crimson tint for failed / blockers, plain well for the rest. No coloured side borders, no glows.
- Data in IBM Plex Sans with tabular figures; Cormorant only for page titles, the hunt status line, the timeline's job title and letters.
- Icons are lucide-react; the design lint enforces no unicode glyph icons or middle-dot strings.
- Motion only for state: the sash drawing, drawers sliding in, meters filling.

## Acceptance

- ✅ **Every spec capability has a place in the UI.** All 13 items of the brief are built (table above). Forms/recipes/traces (A05/A06) and Inbox / plans / gap report (A09) are built against the proposed routes in `requests/A10.md` and show a plain "isn't in this build yet" state today, because those modules are not merged into `v2` yet. They need wiring checks once they land.
- ✅ **The phone layouts work, and the PWA installs.** Bottom tab bar for Campaigns, Pipeline, Questions, Inbox and Digest; every page screenshotted at 390 px with no horizontal overflow. Manifest, PNG and maskable icons and a shell-only service worker are served and checked by selfcheck. Not verified on a physical phone: installation needs HTTPS or localhost, so it applies once Bureau is served over a tunnel or LAN with TLS.
- ✅ **The design system is respected (lead reviews the screenshots).** 54 screenshots in `design/shots/v2/`; the final call is the lead's.

## Known limits and follow-ups

- When A05, A06 and A09 merge, check their route shapes against `requests/A10.md` §1–3 and adjust the types in `web/src/api.ts`; the screens already exist.
- The questions smoke step finds the runner's data dir by looking for the newest `bureau-ui-*` folder; `requests/A10.md` §4 asks A11 to pass `dataDir` instead.
- The demo seed's showcase job has no stored match (A02's recordings are keyed to a different fictional profile), so its timeline says "Not assessed yet" for Match; jobs a real campaign matches show the full table.
- The JS bundle is 574 kB (165 kB gzipped). Route-level code splitting would help first load on a phone; not done to keep the change set contained.
- Telegram, IMAP and the PWA install were exercised only against the UI routes, never with real accounts or a real phone, per the build rules.
